zh-CN.title: 表情包管理焕新
items: 我的表情改用独立管理页，选择与批量删除更清晰
表情资源会主动缓存在本地，并按容量自动清理
删除前增加确认，已移除资源同步退出本地缓存

en.title: A better sticker manager
items: Mine now uses a dedicated manager with clear selection and batch deletion
Sticker assets are proactively cached locally with automatic capacity cleanup
Deletion now requires confirmation and removes discarded assets from local cache
